articles.title: Don't Trash That Pumpkin: Give It a Second Life
articles.summary: Millions of Halloween pumpkins end up in landfills each year, but eating, donating, or burying them can cut waste and help the planet.

articles.title: Harry Styles Replays His 2010 Audition at Harryween
articles.summary: On Oct. 30 at Madison Square Garden, Harry Styles recreated his 2010 X Factor audition look and sang 'Isn't She Lovely' on the 29th night of his 30-show residency.

articles.title: This iPhone App Turns Your Lost Scrolling Hours Black
articles.summary: Oh My Hours for iPhone turns each day into circles for hours, marking an hour black when a distracting app takes it, with quiet hours and resets.
